lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What do you want to do tomorrow?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù shāngdiàn mǎi dōngxi.
lines.english: I want to go to the shop to buy things.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Mǎi shuǐguǒ hé cài. Nǐ yào qù ma?
lines.english: Buy fruit and vegetables. Do you want to go?

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ hé nǐ yīqǐ qù.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 那我们明天早上九点见。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn jiàn.
lines.english: Then we meet tomorrow morning at nine.
